title: UX Navigation Graph Compiler
description: Validates the navigation graph: every screen is reachable from entry points, all transitions target valid nodes, protected routes declare guards, no cyclic traps exist, and 404 handling is declared. Produces navigation-artifact.json consumed by user-flow and permission-branch compilers.

pipeline.title: Parse Intent
pipeline.description: Extract navigation-spec.json from sitemap, route inventory, and auth policy

pipeline.title: Structure
pipeline.description: Validate node structure, entry points, and transition targets

pipeline.title: Policy
pipeline.description: Validate guards, 404 handling, and cycle detection

gates.title: Spec Valid
gates.description: navigation-spec.json exists with nodes array (each having id, transitions) and entryPoints array

gates.title: Entry Points Valid
gates.description: Every id in entryPoints references an existing node

gates.title: Transition Targets Valid
gates.description: Every transition.to references an existing node id

gates.title: No Orphan Routes
gates.description: Every node is reachable from at least one entry point (BFS from all entry points)

gates.title: Back Path Valid
gates.description: Every non-entry node has at least one incoming transition

gates.title: Guards Declared
gates.description: Every protected node (auth=true or visibility != public) declares a guard or redirectOnFail

gates.title: 404 State Declared
gates.description: A 404/not-found state is declared in the graph or notFoundHandledExternally=true

gates.title: No Cyclic Trap
gates.description: No strongly connected component of size > 1 lacks an exit edge to a node outside the component

gates.title: Navigation Contract
gates.description: Full contract check: version, unique ids, transition triggers, auth-visibility alignment

contracts.description: Structural requirements for all compiled navigation graphs

error_codes.UNG001: navigation-spec.json missing or invalid — nodes array and entryPoints required
error_codes.UNG002: Entry point id does not reference a valid node in the graph
error_codes.UNG003: Orphan route — node is unreachable from all declared entry points
error_codes.UNG004: Protected node missing guard — auth=true or visibility != public requires a guard declaration
error_codes.UNG005: Node has no incoming transitions and is not an entry point
error_codes.UNG006: Transition target not found — transition.to references a non-existent node id
error_codes.UNG007: No 404/not-found state declared in navigation graph
error_codes.UNG008: Cyclic navigation trap — SCC with no exit edge detected
error_codes.UNG009: Navigation contract violation — version missing, duplicate ids, untriggered transitions, or auth-visibility mismatch
